## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers the core and combined PLIDA products generated by `fplida`.
These products are the connective tissue for many downstream examples, so the
guide separates source-backed statements from local synthetic behaviour.

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked here. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, generated smoke data, or foundation files. |
| Unresolved | No source was found in this pass. Do not use as calibration truth. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| Core demographics/vitals | ABS PLIDA and Life Course Dataset sources support the broad idea of an integrated person spine and core demographic/vital concepts drawn from linked administrative sources. | I did not find a public variable-level codebook for generated `CORE_GENDER`, `BIRTH_CTRY_CODE`, or source-specific death-date component coding. |
| Core locations | ABS Life Course sources support annual address/location concepts, common-address household construction, geocoded locations, and the development of Core Locations modules in PLIDA. | I did not find public code labels for generated `ADR_TYP`, `SOURCE_FLAG`, or the exact local DIL `STATE`/ASGS coding conventions used by the compact generator. |
| Core relationships | ABS data-development pages support the existence of Core Relationships modules for parent-child and spouse relationships where possible. | I did not find public labels for generated `COMBINED_CATEGORY`, `COMBINED_STATUS`, or relationship source-marker values. |
| Combined Indigenous flags | Local generator and PLIDA metadata support the derived ever-Aboriginal, ever-TSI, and ever-Indigenous columns by name. | I did not find a public ABS codebook that documents the exact current synthetic derivation inputs or real PLIDA combined-Indigenous construction rule. |

## Product inventory

| Dataset | Metadata products | Current fplida coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| `CORE` | Multiple demographics, locations, and relationships products | Current generator writes compact core demographics, core locations, and core relationships. |
| `COMBINED` | Combined/person-level derived products | Current generator writes combined ever-Indigenous indicators. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-core-combined.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-core-combined.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and direct PLIDA metadata matches. Treat those sampled
domains/distributions as implementation evidence only, not as official source
data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/core-combined-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/core-combined-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | No direct PLIDA name match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `COMBINED` | 4 | 4 | 0 |
| `CORE` | 28 | 28 | 0 |

The direct matches mean the current compact columns align by name with local
PLIDA metadata. Location, relationship, and source-marker categories still need
official PLIDA/Core scoping evidence before being used as real source-data
code lists.

## Official concept summary

ABS core-scoping material describes core demographic/vitals, residence, and
activity concepts for life-course data. The official scoping paper identifies
core vitals as being drawn from multiple linked sources such as ATO client
register, Medicare enrolments, DOMINO, and deaths; residence as based on
available address evidence and rules such as 12/16-month concepts; and
activity flags as coming from datasets such as ITR, payment summaries,
DOMINO, MBS, PBS, AIR, and STP. The local generator mimics the broad shape,
not the full ABS construction methodology.

## Core generated schema and domains

### Core demographics

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SPINE_ID` | Character ID | Internal PLIDA spine key. | Local generator |
| `YEAR_OF_BIRTH`, `MONTH_OF_BIRTH` | Integer | Birth year and month; month should be 1 to 12. | Local generator |
| `BIRTH_CTRY_CODE` | Categorical/code | Birth-country code. | Local generator; official code labels unresolved |
| `CORE_GENDER` | Categorical/code | Core gender derived by local generator. | Local generator; official category mapping unresolved |
| `YEAR_OF_DEATH`, `MONTH_OF_DEATH`, `DAY_OF_DEATH` | Integer/missing | Death date components where death evidence exists. | Local generator |

| `EVER_ABORIGINAL_PERSON` | Boolean/integer flag | Ever identified as Aboriginal in local combined construction. | Local generator |
| `EVER_TSI_PERSON` | Boolean/integer flag | Ever identified as Torres Strait Islander in local combined construction. | Local generator |
| `EVER_INDIGENOUS_PERSON` | Boolean/integer flag | Ever Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander in local combined construction. | Local generator |

## Research uses and limits

Core products should be used as the main synthetic person, location, and
relationship layer. The local schema is useful for downstream joins, household
construction tests, and person-year derivations. It should not be described as
the ABS official PLIDA core algorithm; that algorithm depends on source
availability and detailed rules that are only partially reflected in the
current generator.

## Build implications

1. Keep `SPINE_ID` stable and separate from agency-specific AEUIDs.
2. Add explicit ASGS lookup joins if examples interpret state/SA4/SA2/SA1/mesh
   block labels.
3. Record the local location and relationship source-flag domains in tests
   before relying on them in downstream package builds.
4. Keep combined ever-Indigenous flags as derived indicators and document the
   source inputs used to construct them.

## Validation checks to add

| Check | Evidence basis |

| Core location end date is not before start date. | Local generator. |

| Combined Indigenous flags are logically consistent: `EVER_INDIGENOUS_PERSON` equals Aboriginal or TSI flag. | Local combined derivation. |
